title: Working from Home: A New Way to Be Productive
passage: Many people are now working from home, also known as remote work. This means they do their jobs from their houses instead of going to an office.  Some people think working from home makes them more productive. They say they have fewer distractions at home.  For example, there are no loud colleagues talking or meetings that are not important.  They can also set their own schedule. This means they can work when they feel most energetic.  Others find it hard.  They miss the social interaction with their colleagues.  It can also be difficult to separate work from personal life when you are always at home.  However, with good planning, remote work can be a very effective way to get work done.
